submitted.rationale: Index 0 (Pb0.76Sb0.24) had the highest EQE at 0.0049%, about 5x the other two measurements. XRD shows a Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore-like phase on the Pb-rich side, and PbSb2O6 appears toward the Sb-rich side. PbSb2O6 is wide-gap, so it absorbs little of the 2.4 eV light. Merit went up with Pb content, and index 0 is the most Pb-rich composition in the library.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.00092%, pyrochlore phase, 5x lower than index 0
Measured EQE 0.00089%, near Pb2Sb2O7 stoichiometry, low
